picks.name: Sub Basics
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Animalia. Similar dubby, genre-bending techno/dubstep territory to your Tubby Isiah and Hodge picks.
picks.bio: "Wavelengths 2" (September 28, 2026, Animalia) is a four-track EP -- Lobby, Telepathy, Wonder, Encounter -- carrying Sub Basics' signature dubby interpretations of UK techno, dubstep and tech house, rolling and psychedelic.
picks.why_listen: Classic, rolling dub-techno tools with a genre-bending edge -- versatile groove material for a mid-set stretch.

picks.name: Adam Ten & Yamagucci
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Rekids (already followed).
picks.bio: "Keep Workin'" (September 25, 2026, Rekids) is a two-track release pairing the original with a Radio Slave 'Ink Tones' remix.
picks.why_listen: A driving original plus a heavyweight Radio Slave remix -- reliable peak-time ammunition from a label already in your rotation.
